name: Expo Go SDKs
subtitle: Choose the Expo SDK for your project
description: Community Expo Go iOS builds. Each published SDK is a separate install choice. Not affiliated with Expo or Apple.

apps.name: Expo Go SDK 58
apps.subtitle: SDK 58 projects · iOS 16.4+
apps.localizedDescription: Expo Go for Expo SDK 58 projects. Requires iOS 16.4 or later. Community-built unsigned IPA. Choose the SDK matching your project; import and signing are handled by your LiveContainer setup. These SDK builds share Expo Go's bundle identifier; use LiveContainer's install/duplicate controls if keeping more than one. Release notes: https://github.com/Vaibhavsh0120/Expo-Go-IOS-IPA-Builder/releases/tag/expo-go-sdk58-20261101-034916
